frontmatter.name: Omolade Akinwumi
frontmatter.bio: Hi, I'm Omolade Akinwumi, a DevOps Engineer and Technical Content Creator passionate about making cloud-native infrastructure intuitive and accessible. I specialize in bridging technical engineering with visual storytelling—creating tutorials, architecture walkthroughs, and developer-focused media across the Layer5 and Meshery ecosystems. Dedicated to open source, multi-cloud management, and developer enablement.
